RELEASED 2026-08-21. This proposal's own release_condition -- 'SD-ORIENTING-DECISION-SCALE amend landed (substrate: reachable _orienting_decision clear for resume and on gate-miss ticks; driver: count the decision at the override tick only + emit n_latched_ticks), then re-queue the MECH-489 valence-gating retest' -- is now satisfied in all three parts: SUBSTRATE landed 2026-08-20 (ree-v3 775eb55), DRIVER landed 2026-08-21 (V3-EXQ-910b's sentinel tap on REEAgent.select_action counts the decision at the override tick only and emits n_latched_ticks / n_fresh_orienting_ticks), and the retest is RE-QUEUED as V3-EXQ-910b. Prior gating_reason (2026-08-20, metaworker-chip-20260817-sd-orienting-decision-scale-amend) is fully superseded. NOTE the driver work also CORRECTED that prior reason's own diagnosis: orienting_override_fired is read off the same latched _orienting_last_output, so the 910-lineage n_overrides was itself replicated and was never a trustworthy denominator -- the ~5x figure was a ratio of two inflated numbers, not decision-inflation against a sound override count. MECH-489 keeps pending_retest_after_substrate: true until V3-EXQ-910b RUNS; executed here means dispatched into a queue entry, not answered.

ADJUDICATED DO-NOT-QUEUE 2026-08-26 (igw-235-confirm-evidence-mech-489-lit-0, IGW-20260826-235 GOV-CONFIRM-1 confirmer lane). Status stays `executed` -- that is a true lifecycle fact (V3-EXQ-910b ran 2026-08-22, autopsied failure_autopsy_V3-EXQ-910b_2026-08-23, governance-confirmed 2026-08-25). This note records that NO FURTHER RUN OF THIS LINEAGE SHOULD BE QUEUED, and why, because a session that looks MECH-489 up by claim_id needs to read that here rather than re-derive it.
  (1) THE CONFIRMER SIGNAL IS A FALSE POSITIVE, NOT MISSING EVIDENCE. MECH-489 has THREE indexed, adjudicated experimental entries (V3-EXQ-910 weakens, V3-EXQ-910a weakens, V3-EXQ-910b supports). All three read scoring_excluded='diagnostic_probe' because all three drivers set EXPERIMENT_PURPOSE='diagnostic', so genuine_exp_count=0 and the quadrant reads plausible_unproven. The earlier second exclusion (scoring_excluded='stale_substrate', from pending_retest_after_substrate: true) has since cleared -- that flag flipped true->false at the 2026-08-25 cycle -- so diagnostic_probe is now the SOLE cause.
  (2) THE CAUSE IS ALREADY OWNED. chip-20260826-sd099-diagnostic-adjudicated-flag (open, raised 2026-08-26T07:01:30Z, six seconds before this IGW item spawned) implements the governance-ratified fix -- a structured claims.yaml `diagnostic_evidence_adjudicated` flag set by /failure-autopsy, plus indexer + both skill dirs + AN EXPLICIT MECH-489 BACKFILL. Its predecessor chip-20260821-governance-design-decision-evidence-credit-fix resolved at 07:00:26Z the same morning. A queued experiment here would neither fix nor substitute for that.
  (3) A RE-RUN WOULD BE VACUOUS ON BOTH HALVES (GOV-REUSE-1). TRIGGER half: falsifying signature #1 was fairly hit twice (910: 2.6%/1.5%/0.0%; 910a: 0.0%/0.0%/0.0% on limb_damage_injected / external_hazard_injected / world_rule_shift_occurred) and ree_core/pag/defensive_orienting.py has NO commits since before 910 (verified by git log on the file), so the two-channel onset detector under test is byte-identical to the one already falsified -- a third run re-derives 0/0/0%. DECISION half: retested four days ago by V3-EXQ-910b with the repaired override-tick readout (n_override_ticks=21, unclassified=0).
  (4) NOT blocked_substrate. Nothing is waiting on a build. claims.yaml pending_retest_after_substrate is false; closure node orienting_epistemic_deficit_v3:ORNT-6 (last_updated 2026-08-25) states outright 'this node is not blocked on any further build'.
  (5) THE ONE GENUINELY OPEN QUESTION IS GOVERNANCE-OWNED, NOT QUEUEABLE. ORNT-6's resume_condition asks whether the MIXED read -- driven by C1's same-run legacy-vs-new-tap discrepancy (5.95x overrides / 32.57x decisions), not by C2 valence-gating -- warrants a further discriminating instrument-correctness check, or whether mixed is simply MECH-489's standing read. That node explicitly raised no chip because it is a governance/claim-synthesis disposition call. This session did not pre-empt it.
  KNOWN RE-FIRE RISK, stated rather than papered over: this proposal is status=`executed`, and generate_inter_governance_workset.py's _PROPOSAL_ADJUDICATED_NOT_QUEUEABLE_STATUSES DELIBERATELY excludes `executed` (lifecycle position, not adjudication -- correct in general, since an executed-then-FAILED proposal may want a successor). The queue gate _confirmer_queued_claims also no longer suppresses, V3-EXQ-910b having left the queue. So MECH-489 will keep rendering `ready` in the confirmer lane until the chip in (2) lands its backfill and genuine_exp_count stops reading 0. No generator change was made here: the chip's fix removes MECH-489 from _evidence_confirmer_candidates at the source, and a second tracker for an item that already has an owner is the thing to avoid.

NON-DEGENERACY GUARD in MECH-471's own claims.yaml notes: the local-update interference falsifier is vacuous unless the 'unrelated' competences are DEMONSTRABLY ACQUIRED with above-floor performance and live cross-seed variance; testing interference against competences the agent never had self-routes substrate_not_ready. Confirmed autopsy failure_autopsy_V3-EXQ-890_2026-08-07 (status=confirmed) establishes the acquisition clear-rate at 2/16 seeds on the official fixed-threshold split (5/16 on the cleaner natural split), with H-exploration-init-variance CONFIRMED as necessary-not-sufficient (93 pct of the eventual group gap already present by episode 20 of 160, replicating under both split definitions) and H-hazard-layout-difficulty-variance ELIMINATED via the random-walk anchor control. A discriminative pair queued now would measure interference against competences 69-88 pct of seeds never acquire -- precisely the failure V3-EXQ-875 (precondition_unmet, SD-070 zworld_p0 defect) and its corrected successor V3-EXQ-875a (competence_implementation_gap) already hit twice, both FAIL with evidence_direction unknown. That same confirmed autopsy sets recommended_substrate_queue_entry action=none and recommended_evidence_direction=non_contributory, and routes MECH-471 to /claim-synthesis for the MECH-457<->MECH-471 mechanism cross-reference already flagged by Q-089 -- NOT to a new experiment; it deliberately left the one remaining live hypothesis H-bias-head-ofc-interaction UNQUEUED at the interactive gate as low priority. claims.yaml carries pending_retest_after_substrate=true. Mechanically, V3-EXQ-875a is also STILL IN THE QUEUE (status=claimed by ree-cloud-4 since 2026-08-03T16:50:33Z, estimated_minutes=3300), so the already-in-flight check fires independently.

items.gating_reason: Out-of-domain wrong-route. MECH-177 asserts a CLINICAL PHARMACOLOGICAL disease-modification prediction (a drug durably restoring NREM-to-REM sequencing in MCI/early AD is disease-modifying via pipeline protection, effect larger in early MCI than established AD). Three grounds. (1) The direct structural precedent already ran and failed vacuously: V3-EXQ-673 tested MECH-177's mirror -- sleep-phase compression (SWS 8->3, REM 6->2) applied EARLY (ep 50) vs LATE (ep 150), the same critical-window/stage-dependence structure -- and returned FAIL/non_contributory on 3/3 runs with ARM_A == ARM_B == ARM_C on every metric and late_pred_loss identically 0.0. failure_autopsy_batch9_2026-06-12 (user-confirmed, routing decision 5) diagnosed dominant layer 'Environment/Scale (out-of-domain) + Measurement (degenerate)': clinical AD staging is not instantiable in a 300-episode grid-world. A restoration-timed variant reads the same DVs off the same substrate and would be non-contributory for the same reason. (2) Parent dependency MECH-171 (the vicious cycle this claim proposes to break) and sibling MECH-172 both already carry epistemic_category: out_of_domain in claims.yaml from that same autopsy; dependency INV-048 carries prediction_domain: clinical_pharmacology. MECH-177 is the untagged member of that cluster, which is why the generator still emitted this proposal. (3) MECH-177 additionally needs a pharmacological plane that does not exist and is not planned in ree_core (grep degenerat|dementia|MCI|alzheim over ree_core/ yields only numerical 'degenerate' usages -- zero substrate), plus multi-year progressive neurodegeneration and MCI-vs-AD staging. NOT blocked_substrate: no substrate build releases this. It is out_of_domain in the Q-031 sense -- the test domain is human pharmacological cohorts and no REE substrate, current or planned, settles it. Queuing a V3 experiment here would manufacture a vacuous FAIL against a clinical claim.

items.release_condition: External clinical evidence only -- e.g. the phase II design named in the MECH-177 notes (orexin antagonist + sleep-architecture monitoring vs standard care in MCI; primary endpoint = rate of episodic memory decline). Route future MECH-177 work to /lit-pull, never /queue-experiment. ROOT FIX OWED TO GOVERNANCE (deliberately NOT applied by this session: claims.yaml was held by active TASK_CLAIMS entry igw-auto-igw-189-substrate-ready-sd-probe-warmup-20260719T122208Z, and this session ran headless with no user to adjudicate the conflict): set epistemic_category: out_of_domain on MECH-177 in claims.yaml, matching MECH-171/MECH-172. Until that tag lands, generate_inter_governance_workset._claim_v3_testable() keeps judging MECH-177 v3-testable (out_of_domain is in _UNTESTABLE_EPISTEMIC), so this proposal will respawn as a new IGW experiment item every cycle.

items.blocked_note: No SD/MECH build ticket exists for ARC-008 as literally specified. 2026-08-08 thought-digestion research pass (see claims.yaml ARC-008 digestion_note) found the three-axis eligibility system ARC-008 describes (tau-depth bands, rho-depth strata, routing function G(tau,rho,phi,pi,context)) does NOT exist anywhere in ree-v3/ree_core -- confirmed 2026-09-01 by direct grep: zero hits for tau_band/tau_depth, rho_stratum/rho_depth, phi_regime/depth_phase, eligibility_matrix/M_phi, or the literal string ARC-008 in ree_core/. Only a coarse binary proxy for the phi axis exists (simulation_mode/hypothesis_tag), and that fragment is already independently evidenced under its own stable claim, MECH-094, which does not depend on ARC-008. The digestion note explicitly defers drafting a falsifier or a build ticket until a governance decision is made on whether ARC-008 should be split/reclassified (built phi-fragment folded into/cross-referenced against MECH-094; unbuilt tau/rho portion marked substrate_conditional or excreted) rather than treated as one falsifiable claim -- so the correct next step is NOT /implement-substrate on ARC-008 as-is, it is that governance reclassification decision first (a full research draft already exists per the digestion_note). Do not requeue this proposal until that decision lands.

(1) ENVIRONMENT: CausalGridWorld is single-agent -- ENTITY_TYPES = {empty,wall,resource,hazard,contaminated,agent,waypoint} (NUM_ENTITY_TYPES=7), where 'agent' marks the LEARNER'S OWN cell (causal_grid_world.py:156). There is no other-agent entity type and no constructor parameter to place one, so the claim's confirming signature -- discriminate interveners from passive dynamics -- has no target to tag. hazard_agent_pursuit is a scripted pursuing hazard (MECH-357 pressure fallback), not a self/world-separating other. (2) TAG DERIVATION: ree_core/ has 0 hits for other_selflike / selflike / intervener / multi_agent. The existing AGENCY machinery (SD-029 comparator, MECH-095 TPJ, MECH-353 BlockedAgency) is SELF-agency attribution, not agency attributed to another entity. ree_core/entities/object_file_buffer.py supplies object persistence with SD-049 resource type hints only -- no agentive/animate tag. (3) EMPATHY COUPLING: 0 config knobs for lambda_empathy / v_other_veto, so MECH-036's other-harm veto threshold cannot be scaled by OTHER_SELFLIKE probability. The claim's own NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION (derived tags must show non-zero cross-condition variance) is unsatisfiable when the tags do not exist. Multi-agent social work is scoped V5 in-substrate (ree_core/utils/config.py:9648). No substrate_queue.json entry and no SD id covers this gap, so blocked_by names the architectural anchors rather than an SD. Work-graph: complicated (buildable) -- a named build with no open question -- so the route is /implement-substrate (mint a substrate_queue entry first), NOT another experiment. items.blocked_note: MECH-035 (vector-valued VALENCE ranked by constraint-first / Pareto-lexicographic comparison rather than scalar collapse) has no V3 substrate to exercise, so no non-vacuous experiment is constructible. Probed empirically 2026-09-01 against ree_core/predictors/e3_selector.py. (1) NO VECTOR COMPARATOR: E3TrajectorySelector exposes zero methods matching pareto/lexicographic/constraint/dominance/rank/vector, and select() ranks candidates solely by argmin/argmax/multinomial/topk over the SCALAR J(zeta) = f_weight*F + lambda_eff*M + rho_residue*Phi_R - benefit_weight*B - goal_weight*G (46 scalar-reduction call sites in select(), 0 vector comparators). Every 'dominance' hit in ree_core is F-DOMINANCE (MECH-439), which is the opposite finding -- the scalar F term dominating the sum. (2) COMPONENT STREAMS ABSENT: of the six streams the claim names (HOMEOSTASIS, HARM, TEMPORAL_COHERENCE, SELF_IMPACT error, option volume, inferred other welfare) only HARM is a live per-candidate V3 stream (45 config knobs); the other five have ZERO config surface on REEConfig. TEMPORAL_COHERENCE and inferred-other-welfare have 0 hits anywhere in ree_core; the only 'homeostasis' hit is MECH-120 SHY synaptic-weight normalisation in SWS, unrelated to a valence stream; the nearest SELF_IMPACT analogs (DR-10 self_viability, DR-12 pe_confidence) are generation:v4, default-off, and documented in-source as 'off the V3 critical path; promotes nothing in V3'. Social/other-welfare tags are scoped V5. (3) NOT PER-CANDIDATE: the per-component decomposition (_last_traj_components, V3-EXQ-571) reduces every component to a batch mean via .mean().item(), so components are not retained per candidate even for the one live stream. The claim's own NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION requires the named streams to be independently computable per candidate trajectory AND to show non-zero cross-candidate variance on at least two components SIMULTANEOUSLY, and states explicitly that a one-live-component scenario 'cannot distinguish vector-valued ranking from a scalar collapsed onto that one live component, and should self-route substrate_not_ready rather than count as a verdict'. That precondition is unsatisfiable here. Running anyway would test whether a fixed scalar weighting reproduces the rankings produced by a fixed scalar weighting -- an arithmetic identity that returns the claim's FALSIFYING signature regardless of whether MECH-035 is true, i.e. a vacuous falsification of a candidate claim. Work-graph: complicated (buildable) -- a named build with no open question -- so the route is /implement-substrate (mint a substrate_queue entry first), NOT another experiment. No substrate_queue.json entry and no SD id covers this gap, so blocked_by names the claim's own architectural anchors (ARC-017 stream tags, ARC-003 E3 selection). Verified 2026-09-01: 0 manifests in evidence/experiments/ have ever tagged MECH-035.

items.blocked_note: Substrate gate (EXP-0829 readiness check, 2026-09-01): MECH-043's behavioral half is not constructible on the current substrate. (1) NO PRECISION->DV COUPLING: the claim requires 'misallocation of this channel produce a measurable shift in a hallucination-like DV'. The only hallucination-like DV substrate present is the MECH-095 TPJ agency comparator (misattribution of self-caused events to external agency, ree_core/comparator/tpj_comparator.py). TPJComparator.compare() is a pure function of (z_self_pred, z_self_obs, self.agency_threshold) -- verified by AST: no precision token (current_precision/_running_variance/precision_norm/dacc_precision_scale) appears anywhere in ree_core/comparator/, and agency_threshold is assigned only at construction (agent.py:893 <- config.tpj_agency_threshold), never at runtime. The DV is therefore INVARIANT to a gain sweep of the unsigned channel by construction; the only residual path (precision -> commit gate -> different committed actions -> different z_self trajectory) is a confound, not the 'attributable to THIS channel specifically' attribution the claim demands. The unsigned channel's three real consumers are the E3 commit gate, dACC affective-PE weighting (dacc.py:195), and the SD-020 harm surprise target (agent.py:11243) -- none is an attribution DV. (2) NO DISSOCIATION CONTROL: falsifier (iv) requires demonstrating functional dissociation from MECH-054's signed harm/benefit precision channels, but MECH-054 has ZERO implementation in ree_core (0 occurrences; pi_H/pi_B exist only as an 'Implementation Sketch' in docs/architecture/precision_control.md). There is no signed-channel substrate to dissociate from, so (iv) can be neither confirmed nor falsified. Preconditions (a)/(b)/(c) DO hold and were confirmed: the audited term is unsigned by construction (e3_selector.update_running_variance: prediction_error.pow(2).mean()), live-invoked from the real step loop (e3_selector.py:4151), and influences commitment + learning rate. Owed build routes to /implement-substrate; NO substrate_queue entry currently unblocks MECH-043 (0 entries), so this work is unowned. Queueing a gain sweep now would yield a DV that cannot move for the reason under test -- a null would be uninterpretable between falsifier (iii) and an instrument defect. ARC-109 is deferred to V4; ARC-108 is implemented but substrate_conditional. NOTE: sibling proposal LIT-0830 shares backlog_id EVB-1408 and is deliberately left 'proposed' -- the literature-grounding route is unaffected by this substrate gap.

items.blocked_note: /queue-experiment Step 2.5 stop (2026-09-02). MECH-470 needs a topological term = relational distance to the current anchor along TYPED PATHS over the anchor set. (1) NO EDGE STRUCTURE EXISTS in ree-v3. ree_core/hippocampal/anchor_set.py Anchor carries only (key, z_world, active, created_at, last_accessed, below_threshold_streak, goal_payload) -- zero relational fields -- and AnchorSet exposes zero neighbour/adjacency/path/distance accessors (probed live 2026-09-02, not just read from docs). A repo-wide grep for typed-edge machinery over anchors returns nothing: the sole 'adjacency' hit in ree_core is a grid-placement comment in causal_grid_world.py, and SD-091 'coalition topology' is a star topology over SUBSYSTEMS whose own scope statement excludes edge-level interaction graphs. This is precisely what MECH-468 asserts -- REE's typed relations are each realised as a payload field, a gate, or a scoring term, and NONE is exposed as an edge type over the anchor set. (2) SECOND, INDEPENDENT BLOCKER: the falsifier is a ranking-quality comparison 'on EXISTING ghost-bank traces', and no such traces exist. GhostGoalBank telemetry is aggregate counters (n_candidates_scanned, n_admitted, component_sums); 0 of 4 ghost-related manifests carry per-anchor identity. So there is neither a per-anchor trace to re-rank nor a functional-role label to score ranking quality against. (3) THE GATE IS EXPLICIT IN claims.yaml: MECH-470 is 'gated behind the MECH-468 edge-type inventory spike (the typed-path distance it needs must be recoverable from logged telemetry); no experiment proposal minted'. EXP-1107 was auto-minted by the 2026-09-01 proposal_tick over that instruction. The owed next move is that SPIKE, not an experiment -- MECH-468's own note says 'FIRST MOVE IS A SCOPING SPIKE, NOT A PROBE'; node class complicated (buildable). (4) PARTIAL SPIKE ANSWER ALREADY IN HAND from this pass, in the negative: the typed-path distance is NOT recoverable from the current logged telemetry, so the spike cannot be cleared by reading the existing corpus -- it needs per-anchor ghost-bank trace recording first. (5) Step 2.5c substrate-path overlap gate is CLEAR: the only open substrate_queue entry touching ree_core/hippocampal/ is mech203-valence-pool-admissibility (module.py::_select_valence_weighted_start, severity unset, different function), so nothing corrupting blocks this path -- the block is the absent substrate itself. No script authored, no queue entry appended. Checked by chip-proposal-exp-1107-paced, 2026-09-02T02:52Z.

items.blocked_note: substrate gate (queue-experiment Step 2.5): MECH-474's narrow-form regime menu names FOUR learning regimes, but only THREE exist as learning regimes in the V3 substrate. 'counterfactual simulation' is architecturally WRITE-SUPPRESSED by design: MECH-094 (status stable) mandates that simulation content does not accumulate as committed experience, and MECH-319 (ree_core/regulators/simulation_mode_rule_gate.py) instantiates it as a rule-write gate suppressing arbitration-weight updates during ghost/replay/DMN passes. Confirmed at source: REEAgent._do_replay (agent.py:10397) generates replay trajectories and DISCARDS them (dead assignment, no parameter update); the only replay that drives updates is inside run_rem_attribution_pass, which IS regime 4 (offline consolidation), not regime 3. GhostGoalBank is explicitly 'pure arithmetic; no trainable parameters; no gradient flow'. VsRolloutGate is an input-quality gate, not a learning path. The simulation_mode_rule_gate_admit_writes knob exists but is the V3-EXQ-543c FALSIFIER (predicted to produce monomodal-collapse re-emergence) and reaches only the arbitration-EMA path, not the actor-critic/prediction-loss learning path. CONSEQUENCE: a fixed 'counterfactual simulation' arm would be a structurally inert no-learning arm, so MECH-474's own pre-registered NON-DEGENERACY GUARD (at least two regimes winning on different sub-tasks in the fixed-arm baseline) can never be met by that arm, and experiments/_lib/precondition_gate.assert_no_structurally_unsatisfiable_gate would refuse the run at setup. NOT ROUTABLE TO /implement-substrate AS-IS: building a write-enabled counterfactual learning regime would contradict MECH-094, which is status=stable. This is a GOVERNANCE adjudication (a claims.yaml disposition), not a build: either (a) narrow MECH-474's registered menu to the three learning regimes REE actually has -- after which EXP-0401's fixed-vs-selecting design is buildable as a 3-regime falsifier -- or (b) decide deliberately how a counterfactual-learning regime coexists with MECH-094. The menu must NOT be narrowed silently: MECH-474's notes pre-register it as exactly the four and warn against redesigning it. Recorded by chip-proposal-exp-1110-paced 2026-09-02; re-derive brake count 0; no completed run and no claim_evidence entry for MECH-474; V3-EXQ-976 was reserved and released unused. NOTE: sibling proposal LIT-1111 shares backlog_id EVB-1585 and is deliberately left 'proposed' -- the literature-grounding route is unaffected by this substrate gap.

items.blocked_note: /queue-experiment Step 2.5 + 2.5c stop (2026-09-02). (1) SUBSTRATE ABSENT: MECH-494's DV is context-switch rate under a retain-vs-switch-vs-create arbitration over STORED contexts. No such arbitration exists in ree_core -- there is no active-context state at all (grep for active_context/current_context/context_id/switch_to_context/create_context over ree_core/ returns nothing), matching the claim's own text ('nothing consumes it to arbitrate retain-vs-switch-vs-create over stored contexts'). MECH-288's event_segmenter emits observation-side boundaries only and is consumed as a region KEY, so measuring it would test MECH-288, not MECH-494. (2) TWO OPEN CORRUPTING SUBSTRATE_QUEUE ENTRIES overlap the exact modules any MECH-494 driver must exercise: contextmemory-write-path-addressing-degeneracy (severity corrupting, status implemented_pending_validation, ree_core/predictors/e1_deep.py::ContextMemory.write -- where stored contexts live) and SD-e1-rollout-consistency-training (severity corrupting, status item1_validated_item2_pending, e1_deep.py::forward / ::predict_long_horizon -- the forward model that would produce the explanatory-failure signal). Both statuses contain 'pending' and are therefore OPEN per Step 2.5c. (3) ENVIRONMENT IS PARTLY THERE, better than the 2026-08-19 intake assumed: transient surprise (transient_events_enabled / scheduled_external_hazard_enabled), sensor noise (weather_field_enabled -- agent-independent continuous perturbation of the hazard percept), gradual drift (background_drift_enabled, drift_policy=random_walk), and -- the discriminating action-consequence condition -- world_rule_shift (SD-MEL-PRODUCER, IMPLEMENTED 2026-07-21: re-permutes the action->displacement map so the scene is unchanged while action consequences invert) all exist. STILL MISSING: (a) RECURRENCE -- world_rule_shift applies cumulative RANDOM transpositions so a rule never returns, and without recurring contexts 'switch back to a stored context' is indistinguishable from 'create a new one', which is the exact trichotomy under test; (b) an abrupt OBSERVATION-side latent transition (world_rule_shift_scope hard-rejects anything but 'action_map'). ROUTE: /implement-substrate for the arbitrator plus the recurring-context environment pair -- both 2026-08-19 intakes independently say 'build the 2x2 environment family once, for both' and 'do not queue an experiment yet'. NOT AUTHORED: an experiment now could only implement the criterion inside the driver, which would test the driver rather than the substrate. Also note MECH-153 (ContextMemory undifferentiated without a supervised context-labeling objective) and MECH-309 (monostrategy collapse) remain live and would each independently null this run, per the intake's own precondition check.

items.blocked_note: MECH-530's own claims.yaml entry (claim_type: design_decision, subject: e3.non_oracular_output_typing) states verbatim in its notes: 'DO NOT queue an experiment against this claim -- it is a static/contract property, not one an experiment run would move.' Confirmed by independent re-inspection 2026-09-02: MECH-530 asserts a STATIC INTERFACE CONTRACT on E3's EXISTING output surface -- that every decision-outcome field is a continuous/boolean/count-typed magnitude and none is a semantic category label. Its truth value is a property of source code at a point in time, not of any run's behaviour, so NO experiment output varies with it and no run can confirm or falsify it. Re-verified directly: SelectionResult (e3_selector.py:114-132) is Trajectory/int/torch.Tensor/float/bool only; the 77 last_score_diagnostics writes are bool/int/float; the single label-adjacent field, loop_named_channel_routed_ranges, is Dict[str, float] keyed by ARCHITECTURAL loop-channel names (associative/limbic, from cmap) carrying continuous range values -- a descriptive-string key with a typed value, which the claim explicitly permits, not an object/context class label. The claim already reads CONFIRMED-by-inspection in its own what_would_answer with no build owed. What IS owed is the instrument the claim's notes name as 'not yet written': a CONTRACT TEST over e3_selector.py's diagnostic surface, guarding against a future addition leaking a category label. That is /implement-substrate work (a 'complicated (buildable)' node -- a named build with no open question), not an EXQ run. Substrate gates were run and are CLEAN, so this is explicitly NOT a substrate gap: Step 2.5b re-derive brake = 0 autopsies on MECH-530; Step 2.5c substrate-path overlap = 0 open substrate_queue entries touching e3_selector.py. Skipped rather than blocked_substrate for the same reason as EXP-0273/ARC-080: queue-experiment Step 2.5 is for a buildable/probe-gated node, whereas this is a claim-testability guardrail. Also confirmed: MECH-530 has no completed run (absent from claim_evidence.v1.json, evidence: []) and implementation_phase is still v3 (unchanged since the 2026-09-01 triage). PROVENANCE: EXP-1153 was auto-minted by the 2026-09-01 proposal_tick mass-mint with the generic template objective 'Reduce uncertainty for MECH-530 via targeted experiment runs' and why_now 'missing_experimental_evidence' -- derived mechanically from the claim having no evidence rows, without checking whether the claim is experiment-shaped. A design_decision claim can never accrue experimental evidence rows, so that signal will keep re-minting this proposal; see the massmint triage doc evidence/planning/proposal_tick_massmint_triage_20260901.md. 2026-09-02, session metaworker-chip-proposal-exp-1153-paced, chip chip-proposal-exp-1153-paced.

items.gating_reason:
EVB-0633 / EXP-0379 (auto-generated generic 'reduce uncertainty for ARC-130 via targeted experiment runs') DECLINED at the /queue-experiment substrate-readiness guardrail by headless IGW session IGW-20260826-234 (2026-08-26). Three independent gates, any one of which is sufficient.

(1) NO MEASUREMENT SURFACE FOR THE LADDER, AND BUILDING ONE IS EXPLICITLY UNAUTHORISED BY THE CLAIM ITSELF. ARC-130's unit of analysis is the furthest causal-reach STAGE demonstrated (existence / representation / endogenous recruitment / local operation / competitive authority / committed throughput / ecological consequence / retention). Verified 2026-08-26 that no such per-stage instrumentation exists anywhere in ree-v3: grep for mechanism_reach|reach_trace|reach_stage|causal_reach|ladder_stage|furthest_stage across ree_core/ and experiments/ returns nothing, ARC-130 appears in no substrate/experiment/test file, and a runtime probe (REEConfig.from_dims, ree-v3 afc6986) returns an EMPTY list of reach/ladder/throughput/*_stage fields. ARC-130's own claims.yaml notes then close the obvious route: 'DO NOT build a new "MechanismReachTrace" runtime object or dedicated telemetry schema from this claim without a separate build decision ... recorded as an UNBUILT instrumentation proposal here, not authorised.' Any experiment measuring the ladder must first build that schema, so queuing one now would breach the claim's own registered gate.

(2) THE CLAIM'S TESTABLE EMPIRICAL CORE IS ALREADY DEMONSTRATED FOUR TIMES OVER -- a new run would re-derive, not inform. ARC-130's post-ARC-120 contribution is the assertion that competitive authority at an internal selection boundary does NOT entail committed throughput. The confirmed, human-gated failure_autopsy_931-932-wanting-authority-cluster_2026-08-16 (V3-EXQ-931) already establishes exactly that dissociation quantitatively: (a) AUTHORITY -- wanting_authority_ratio ~= 0.0037, selection_flip_rate 0.0 in 5/5 seeds at the documented operating weight; (b) THROUGHPUT -- at w=5000, 80.3 pct of genuine refits flip the CEM elite argmin while mean_resource_proximity is BIT-IDENTICAL to ablation (0.6229773644254133), because select_action re-scores the pool with e3.last_scores independently of the CEM's pick. That is authority achieved and throughput exactly zero. ree-v3 1a4b6be records it as the FOURTH convergent instance of 'scoring-layer signals do not reach the committed argmax', after MECH-314 curiosity bias, MECH-320 vigor penalty and MECH-341 within-class temperature. Note the formal Step 2.5b re-derive brake does NOT fire (ARC-130 has zero autopsies -- it was registered 2026-08-25), but the condition that brake protects against is present here in a stronger form: the phenomenon is established, so the marginal information of a fifth instance is ~nil. The owed action is EVIDENCE TAGGING of the existing cluster to ARC-130, not a new run -- see release_condition.

(3) THE LADDER'S UPPER STAGES ARE BEHAVIOURALLY BLOCKED, AND ITS DISTINCTIVE STAGE IS DEFAULT-OFF AND KNOWN-BROKEN. 'Ecological consequence' (the changed behaviour has a valid opportunity to matter) sits squarely behind the known conversion / F-dominance ceiling, so a run reaching for it FAILs for the already-understood reason -- a vacuous result, not a verdict. One stage down, 'committed throughput' is gated behind four default-OFF knobs (probe 2026-08-26: use_natural_commit_latch_hold=False, use_closure_commit_entry=False, use_closure_commit_entry_trajectory=False, use_persistent_committed_program_handle=False) and, per diagnostic_arc071_commit_latch_h1h2_probe_2026-07-31.md (H1 CONFIRMED, H2 REFUTED), _committed_step_idx never advances past 1 across 80 ticks and 8-10 full E3 re-deliberation cycles -- 'there is no genuinely multi-step-persisting commitment to misread'. The companion diagnostic_arc071_e3_reselection_probe_2026-08-01.md confirms the separate E3 unconditional-re-commit defect as a REAL, named, still-open build. So the ladder rung ARC-130 uniquely contributes is not merely unmeasured, it is not reliably instantiated in the running organism.

SUPPORTING (not independently sufficient): all four depends_on claims (ARC-120, MECH-480, GOV-FAILLOC-1, ARC-131) are status=candidate with ZERO evidence, and MECH-480 is v3_pending=true. ARC-130 refines ARC-120's post-authority granularity, but ARC-120 itself has no experimental evidence, so testing the refinement ahead of the base is out of order. ARC-130 also carries its own unresolved VERSION-ROUTING FLAG asking a future /governance session to confirm v3 scoping vs a v4/v4_v5 park like sibling ARC-128; queuing a V3 run now would pre-empt that decision. The why_now signals that generated this proposal (missing_experimental_evidence, lit_only_above_cap, synthetic_signals_only, low_exp_conf) are expected-and-benign for an architectural_commitment AUDIT-PROJECTION claim whose own source thought states 'It does not presently justify a new cognitive module' -- they indicate claim TYPE, not a remediable evidence defect.

[2026-08-26 UPDATE, chip-20260826-arc130-authority-throughput-evidence-tagging]: release_condition (a) is now satisfied. The existing V3-EXQ-931/932 cluster autopsy and the two ARC-071 diagnostics (H1/H2 commit-latch persistence, E3 reselection) are cross-tagged into ARC-130's claims.yaml evidence_quality_note (diagnostic_evidence_adjudicated=true), adjudicated CONFIRMED-SUPPORTS for the claim's testable core. items.release_condition:
Do NOT re-offer this as an experiment proposal until BOTH of the following resolve; neither is an experiment, and the first may retire the proposal outright.

(a) EVIDENCE TAGGING FIRST (route: /claim-synthesis or /governance, NOT /queue-experiment). ARC-130's authority-does-not-entail-throughput core is already demonstrated by the confirmed V3-EXQ-931/932 wanting-authority cluster autopsy plus the three prior convergent instances (MECH-314 curiosity bias, MECH-320 vigor penalty, MECH-341 within-class temperature) and the ARC-071 commit-latch H1/H2 + E3-reselection diagnostics. Cross-tag that existing evidence to ARC-130 and re-assess. If the tagged evidence discharges the claim's experimental debt -- the likely outcome -- this proposal should move from blocked_substrate to gated/executed rather than ever being queued, and the why_now signals (missing_experimental_evidence, synthetic_signals_only) will clear on their own.

(b) A SEPARATE, EXPLICIT BUILD DECISION on the per-stage causal-reach instrumentation that ARC-130's own notes record as UNBUILT and NOT AUTHORISED, taken together with the governance ruling the claim's VERSION-ROUTING FLAG requests (confirm implementation_phase v3, or park v4/v4_v5 alongside ARC-128). If governance parks it v4/v4_v5, this proposal is moot on the V3 substrate and should be retired, not re-queued. If governance confirms v3 AND authorises the instrumentation, the node is 'complicated (buildable)' -- a named build with no open question -- so the correct next route is /implement-substrate for the reach-stage telemetry, NOT an experiment. Only once that telemetry exists and can distinguish competitive authority from committed throughput per-mechanism at runtime does an ARC-130 experiment become 'complex (probe-gated)' and therefore queueable.

Additionally, any future ARC-130 experiment must NOT depend on the 'ecological consequence' or 'retention/generalisation' rungs while the conversion / F-dominance ceiling stands -- a FAIL there re-derives the known ceiling and is non-contributory by construction. Scope any such run to rungs at or below committed throughput, and only after the ARC-071 E3 unconditional-re-commit defect (diagnostic_arc071_e3_reselection_probe_2026-08-01.md, named fix, still open) is closed so that committed throughput is reliably instantiated rather than pinned at _committed_step_idx=1.

items.blocked_note: Substrate readiness check (/queue-experiment Step 2.5) against substrate_queue.json sd_id=mech142-no-valence-arousal-orthogonal-axis-substrate (node_class: mystery (known data), scoped 2026-08-25, chip-20260824-mech142-ach-gating-falsifier-scope): MECH-142's claim premise (an ACh-analog gating mechanism maintains orthogonality between independent valence and arousal control-plane axes) has no substrate referent. grep across ree_core for cholinerg|acetylchol|axis_orthogonality|orthogonality_maintenance|decorrelat returns zero hits (confirmed again 2026-08-29) -- no dataclass field, no from_dims param, no consumption site in REEConfig. Worse, valence and arousal are CORRELATED BY CONSTRUCTION in the current design, not merely undecorrelated: CeA's valence signal and BLA's arousal_tag are both nonlinear functions of the SAME z_harm_a (SD-011) magnitude, and ree_core/amygdala/cea.py:77-82 states this is a deliberate architecture decision ('CeA must fire on harm-affective valence, NOT generic arousal ... magnitude there IS affective valence load'). So there are no independent degrees of freedom to drift toward correlation in the first place. A prior attempt (V3-EXQ-164a) built a bespoke, non-ree_core proxy harness with proxy tonic/phasic/affect axes and a non-differentiable decorrelation loss (zero gradient reaching any trained parameter) -- its bit-identical WITH/NO_DECORRELATION result is a harness defect, not a substrate finding. This is not a buildable gap: per the substrate_queue.json entry, governance/design must first decide whether to (A) build genuine orthogonal valence/arousal axes (which would contradict the CeA/BLA design intent), or (B) reframe MECH-142 onto a different, already-orthogonal control-plane channel pair (e.g. two of MECH-063's 8 neuromodulator-analog axes) before any experiment can be queued. Not queued as a matter of course for this reason; see substrate_queue.json for the full scoping writeup.

items.design: Discriminative pair, 3 matched seeds (42, 43, 44). Substrate-level forced-injection design (avoids env-loop noise floor that produced V3-EXQ-140 non_contributory): N_REAL=50 deterministic real events + N_SIM=50 deterministic sim events at disjoint z_world locations, called directly on ResidueField.accumulate / update_valence. ARM_A (TAG_ROUTING_ON): sim events pass hypothesis_tag=True -> gate active -> RBF weights NOT updated for sim. ARM_B (TAG_ROUTING_OFF, gate ablation by passing wrong tag): sim events pass hypothesis_tag=False -> gate inactive -> RBF weights updated for sim. Three pre-registered metrics: M1 write_channel_contamination_index (sum sim weight delta / sum real weight delta); M2 confabulation_rate (fraction of sim locations whose post-experiment RBF signature exceeds median real signature); M3 routing_separation (MI in nats between tag and write_occurred). Pre-registered thresholds: C1 ARM_A contam<0.05 AND ARM_B contam>0.50 AND delta>0.40 in 2/3 seeds; C2 ARM_A confab<=0.05 AND ARM_B confab>=0.30 in 2/3 seeds; C3 ARM_A MI>=0.50 AND ARM_B MI<=0.05 in 2/3 seeds. Smoke 2026-04-29: PASS in 3/3 seeds with ARM_A=(0.000, 0.000, 0.693) ARM_B=(1.000, 0.640, 0.000).
items.executed_note: PASS (3/3 seeds, all three criteria). ARM_A contam=0.000, confab=0.000, MI=0.693 (perfect log(2)); ARM_B contam=1.000, confab=0.640, MI=0.000. Elapsed 0.08s on DLAPTOP-4.local. items.design: Single-condition substrate-readiness run (not a discriminative pair). Verify all four sleep phases (wake / replay-prep / replay / test) fire with measurable signatures during a 100k-step episode that includes at least 3 simulated sleep cycles. Pre-registered thresholds: (a) phase_entry_count >= 3 per cycle for each of the four phases, (b) phase_duration_variance within 20% of design spec, (c) replay_quality (precision-weighted hippocampal SWR-equivalent count) >= baseline value documented in V3-EXQ-265 PASS. PASS = all three thresholds met -> green light to queue the discriminative ablation as a follow-up (EXP-0171a, separate proposal after this lands). FAIL = identifies which phase substrate is broken, drives /diagnose-errors before further sleep work.

items.design: Discriminative pair, 3 matched seeds (42, 43, 44). ARM_A (FULL_4_PHASE_ON, sws_enabled=True + rem_enabled=True): full SWS schema pass writes prototypes; REM attribution rolls out against theta_buffer.recent. ARM_B (NO_SLEEP_BASELINE, both flags off): same call short-circuits. Three pre-registered metrics: M1 cumulative_sws_writes (ARM_A>=N_CYCLES, ARM_B==0); M2 ctxmem_state_change Frobenius norm of (memory_after - memory_before) (ARM_A>=0.10, ARM_B<=1e-6 -- magnitude probe agnostic to slot-diversity direction since SWS write can REDUCE diversity by clustering slots around real prototype geometry); M3 cumulative_rem_rollouts (ARM_A>=N_CYCLES, ARM_B==0). PASS criteria: all three in 2/3 seeds. Smoke 2026-05-01: PASS in 3/3 seeds (ARM_A: sws_writes=24, ctxmem_delta~4.6-5.0, rem_rollouts=18; ARM_B: zeros). regression --changed sleep 48/48 PASS. PASS supports SD-017 architecture (sleep substrate produces measurable work that does not happen without it); FAIL with C1 alone routes to a downstream consumer gap; FAIL with C1 also failing routes to a substrate gap V3-EXQ-500 readiness probe missed.

acceptance_checks: E1: A0 reproduces the failure regime: mean cross-context z_world cosine >= 0.95 and low separation_gap, matching V3-EXQ-418f/g/h.
E2: At least one enriched arm reaches mean cross-context z_world cosine < 0.90 and separation_gap >= A0 + 0.05 across matched seeds.
E3: Enriched-arm z_world effective rank is at least 2x A0 effective rank, or >= 8 absolute effective dimensions, whichever is stricter.
E4: Linear probes from frozen z_world exceed 0.75 balanced accuracy for context identity and transition_type, and exceed 0.65 for self-caused vs env-caused event source.
E5: Resource/hazard proximity probes from z_world achieve R2 >= 0.30 for both hazard and resource targets.
E6: Action-conditioned next-z_world prediction beats action-shuffled control by >= 25% MSE reduction.

PASS = E1 plus E2 plus at least three of E3-E6. PASS licenses SD-016 retest and MECH-273/MECH-275 sleep-writeback retests under the passing enriched env arm. FAIL means the environment still does not supply enough causal information; do not rerun SD-016/sleep substrates until a richer env extension is designed.

For each arm, train the same short agent schedule with alpha_world=0.9, sd016_enabled=True, use_event_classifier=True, and use_resource_proximity_head=True. Collect balanced eval batches across safe, dangerous, resource-rich, delayed-consequence, self-caused, and env-caused contexts. items.design: 3-condition x 3-seed: (A) SIMPLE/normal_gain (baseline), (B) SIMPLE/reduced_gain (multiply z_goal seeding gain by 0.2), (C) LONG_HORIZON/elevated_gain (multiply gain by 5). Measure: z_goal_norm, HABIT/PLANNED gap. Both directions covered. result=supports/PASS.
items.notes: Maps to SSRI mechanism: not mood elevation per se, but recalibration of the approach system responsiveness to terrain signals. Bidirectional prediction (gain reduction causes depression; gain elevation rescues) is what distinguishes MECH-187 from MECH-186 (terrain maintenance). Requires gain parameter in z_goal seeding module.
items.objective: Test bidirectional gain effects on z_goal seeding: reduced gain replicates depression in SIMPLE/LOW_HARM condition; elevated gain rescues LONG_HORIZON from depression attractor. Bidirectional prediction is a strong discriminating test.

items.design: 2-condition x 3-seed: (A) LONG_HORIZON/no_injection (baseline), (B) LONG_HORIZON/z_goal_injected (add constant z_goal_seed=0.3 to action selection phase, bypassing terrain-based seeding). INV-052 (EXP-0101) tests whether any single mechanism is sufficient. MECH-188 is a top-down override, distinct from terrain manipulation (MECH-186) and gain regulation (MECH-187).
items.objective: Test whether injecting a sustained z_goal signal (simulating PFC top-down goal persistence) prevents behavioral flattening during LONG_HORIZON even when benefit terrain has collapsed.

items.design: 5-condition x 3-seed: (A) SIMPLE/no_interventions (healthy baseline), (B) LONG_HORIZON/no_interventions (depression baseline), (C) LONG_HORIZON/terrain_floor_only (MECH-186), (D) LONG_HORIZON/elevated_gain_only (MECH-187), (E) LONG_HORIZON/goal_injection_only (MECH-188). Compare z_goal_norm and HABIT/PLANNED gap for each condition vs healthy baseline. A full combined-mechanisms condition (all three together) can optionally be added as condition F to test whether all three together do restore baseline.

key_sources: Huys, Daw & Dayan (2021) - Depression: A decision-theoretic analysis (Annual Review of Neuroscience) -- reward learning in depression, pruning, and effort
Adams, Huys & Roiser (2016) - Computational psychiatry: towards a mathematically informed understanding of mental illness (Journal of Neurology, Neurosurgery & Psychiatry)
Dayan & Huys (2008) - Serotonin, inhibition, and negative mood (PLOS Computational Biology) -- 5-HT and reward modulation
Eshel & Roiser (2010) - Reward and punishment processing in depression (Biological Psychiatry) -- anhedonia as reward sensitivity deficit
Treadway & Zald (2011) - Reconsidering anhedonia in depression: lessons from translational neuroscience (Neuroscience and Biobehavioral Reviews) -- wanting vs liking in clinical anhedonia
items.notes: Key framing contribution: REE locates depression at the terrain/seeding layer, not the value-learning layer. This is architecturally distinct from existing computational psychiatry models and should be documented as such in the paper. Executed 2026-04-18: 4 of 5 proposed sources already covered in targeted_review_inv_053 (Adams 2016, Dayan 2008, Eshel 2010, Treadway 2010); added Huys/Daw/Dayan 2015 decision-theoretic review as 5th entry (the proposal's '2021' date was incorrect -- the Annual Review paper is 2015, PMID 25705929).
items.objective: Ground INV-053 (computational depression attractor) in computational psychiatry, distinguishing motivational terrain collapse from aberrant reward learning. Huys/Dayan/Adams lineage focuses on incorrect Q-values and precision weighting; INV-053 is about the substrate (benefit terrain, z_goal seeding) degrading. Establish this as a distinct failure mode.

key_sources: Nesse (2000) - Is depression an adaptation? (Archives of General Psychiatry) -- ecological/functional framing of depression maintenance
Petersen et al. (2014) or Gotlib & Hammen (2008) -- depression maintenance and rumination as self-sustaining loop

items.notes: The key empirical constraint is treatment response latency (2-4 weeks for SSRIs). If recovery were graded, immediate partial response would be expected. Delayed non-linear response supports attractor/phase-transition account. This grounding is important for the paper's psychiatric section credibility.
items.objective: Ground INV-054 (depressive maintenance loop as self-sustaining attractor; recovery as phase transition) in clinical depression phenomenology and treatment response literature. Phase-transition prediction (non-linear, delayed recovery) is a unique testable consequence of the INV-054 maintenance loop.

items.design: Train E2_harm_s with SD-013 interventional contrast (counterfactual perturbation during training). Evaluate residual_harm = z_harm_s_observed - E2_harm_s(z_harm_s_{t-1}, a_actual) per step. Tag steps by event type (approach-to-harm, self-caused-hazard, externally-caused-hazard, baseline). Compute residual magnitude per event class, expect partial attenuation on self-caused relative to externally-caused (Shergill ~50% pattern). PASS: C1 forward_r2 >= 0.9; C2 self-vs-external attenuation ratio between 0.3-0.7 (partial, not binary); C3 SNR > 3 on approach-to-harm events. items.design: Three-arm ablation. Arm A: E2_harm_s trained comparator-only (post-action residual loss). Arm B: trained evaluator-only (rollout value loss). Arm C: trained jointly with mode-label gating input. Measure per-arm: comparator SNR on approach-to-harm events; evaluator accuracy (predicted vs realised trajectory value) at horizon k=5,10. FAIL: Arm C significantly degrades one or both modes -> separate substrates required. 4 seeds.

items.design: Three-arm ablation on a fixed foraging task with scheduled micro-quiescence windows (MECH-092). (A) Intact: SD-032a emits the full operating_mode vector; gates read the vector normally. (B) Coordinator ablated: SD-032a output clamped to a constant external_task one-hot; per-substrate gates retain their local mode-dependent logic but receive a fixed input. (C) No-mode-gating null: gates replaced with permanently-open local heuristics (no dependence on operating_mode). Across arms measure: (i) post-quiescence trajectory-selection bias toward recently replayed trajectories (Tambini-Davachi-analog: cosine similarity between replay content and next-trajectory embedding); (ii) cross-mode write bleed during external_task commitment (writes to viability map originating from replay content); (iii) downstream policy change rate per unit replay event. PASS (MECH-261 supported): Arm A > Arm B ~= Arm C on metric (i); Arm A shows segregated write bleed while B and C do not. FAIL-coordinator (MECH-261 over-specified for coordinator role): Arm B reproduces Arm A on metric (i) -- gating is local. FAIL-gate (MECH-261 over-specified entirely): Arm C reproduces Arm A -- mode gating unnecessary. 5 seeds per arm; success threshold = pairwise Cohen's d >= 0.8 on metric (i) between distinguishing arms.
items.notes: Causal test of the salience-network-as-coordinator overlay flagged in targeted_review_systems_consolidation_waking_propagation/synthesis.md. Rodent replay literature does not directly validate the coordinator role; this is a REE-specific prediction. Cannot run until V3 SD-032 cluster is at least minimally implemented. Metric (i) maps onto Tambini & Davachi 2019 forward-cognitive-bias finding; metric (ii) onto Rothschild et al 2017 cortical-hippocampal-cortical loop; metric (iii) onto Peyrache et al 2009 PFC-replay-drives-rule-update.
items.objective: Falsify (or support) the MECH-261 claim that a shared operating-mode vector from SD-032a is load-bearing for forward-propagation of internal_replay content into subsequent external_task action selection. Core hypothesis: lesioning the coordinator abolishes the post-quiescence action-selection bias; local per-substrate gating alone does not reproduce it.
prerequisites: SD-032a implemented (salience-network coordinator emitting operating_mode vector)
MECH-261 implemented (at least E3 policy-write gate, PFC-analog write gate, and cortical-sensory buffer write gate keyed to mode vector)

items.design: Four-arm per-subdivision write-gate manipulation on a fixed task that includes scheduled internal_replay windows (MECH-092) and explicit internal_planning rollouts (E2) in addition to external_task action selection. Arm A (intact): all SD-033 write-gates obey their MECH-261 mode profile normally. Arm B (SD-033a write-gate forced open during internal_replay): the lateral-PFC-analog rule substrate becomes writeable from replay content during quiescence -- replay can overwrite the rule substrate. Predicted signature: rule drift / forgetting after replay events. Arm C (SD-033b write-gate forced closed during internal_planning): the OFC-analog outcome-prediction substrate cannot accept writes during E2 rollouts -- planning cannot deposit speculative outcome predictions. Predicted signature: degraded counterfactual rollout quality (E2 outcome predictions lose calibration against held-out rollout-realisation pairs). Arm D (null: no mode gating at all): all SD-033 substrates are write-open in every mode. Predicted signature: cross-mode contamination in BOTH the rule substrate (rule drift) AND the outcome substrate (replay content bleeding into external-task outcome predictions). Per arm, measure: (i) rule-representation drift across replay events -- cosine distance of SD-033a activity for the same rule cue pre vs post a replay window; (ii) counterfactual rollout quality -- E2 / SD-033b prediction accuracy against held-out (state, action) -> outcome pairs after planning episodes; (iii) cross-mode content leakage -- decoder probe testing whether internal_replay content (replayed trajectory embeddings) is detectable in SD-033b representations during external_task commitment. Success criterion (MECH-261 per-subdivision profile supported): per-arm signatures dissociate in the predicted direction with pairwise Cohen's d >= 0.8 between Arm A and each manipulated arm on at least 5 seeds, AND Arm A is statistically distinguishable from Arm D on both rule drift and rollout quality. FAIL-route-A (rule substrate not protected by mode gating): Arm B == Arm A on rule drift -- forced-open SD-033a write-gate produces no rule drift, suggesting the mode profile is not load-bearing for the rule substrate specifically. FAIL-route-B (planning substrate write-gate redundant): Arm C == Arm A on rollout quality -- closing SD-033b during planning does not degrade rollouts, suggesting writes were not landing there during planning anyway. FAIL-cluster (mode gating per se unnecessary): Arm D == Arm A on all three metrics -- even fully open gates produce no contamination, mode-conditioned write gating is over-specified.
items.notes: Sibling experiment to EXP-0148, NOT a replacement. EXP-0148 tests the coordinator overlay (does SD-032a-clamping abolish aggregate forward-propagation bias?); EXP-0149 tests per-subdivision write-landing under each mode (do writes actually land in the correct SD-033 subdivision?). Both tests are needed to fully characterise MECH-261: EXP-0148 establishes that the coordinator is load-bearing at all; EXP-0149 establishes that the per-subdivision routing inside the MECH-261 family is functionally specific (not just one coarse on/off gate dressed up as a vector). A coordinator could pass EXP-0148 while failing EXP-0149 by producing the right aggregate bias with mis-routed internal writes; that pattern would force a refinement of MECH-261's specification. Cannot run until SD-032a + SD-033a + SD-033b + MECH-261 + MECH-092 are all implemented in V3 -- proposal-only at registration time. Do not queue in ree-v3/experiment_queue.json until those substrates exist.
items.objective: Test whether MECH-261's per-subdivision write-landing profile is correctly mode-routed -- distinct from the coordinator-level test in EXP-0148. EXP-0148 asks whether the coordinator overlay produces the right aggregate forward-propagation bias; EXP-0149 asks whether writes actually land in the correct PFC subdivision (SD-033a vs SD-033b) under each mode. A coordinator could pass EXP-0148 by producing the right aggregate bias while writes are mis-routed internally between subdivisions; only a per-subdivision lesion design can dissociate that.

items.design: Two-arm. Arm A (closure-operator OFF): rule completes, no explicit closure signal. items.design: Three-arm delay-to-reward task. Arm A (baseline Hold): standard MECH-090 bistable latch + SD-033a rule_state update gated by MECH-261. items.design: Three-arm cross-mode rule-binding task. items.design: Two-arm. Arm A (MECH-268 OFF): default dACC pe signal with no saturation cap. items.design: Three-arm task on a three-alternative decision variant of CausalGridWorldV2. Measure: (i) per-goal pursuit fraction and entropy across episodes; (ii) trials-to-criterion on the novel rule; (iii) monostrategy index (fishtank-style viz); (iv) importance-vector entropy over trials. Predicted: Arm B uniquely displays both over-focus AND novel-rule impairment; Arms C and D dissociate the two deficits. items.design: Two-arm matched-seed discriminative pair on a gridworld variant with a designated schema region R (e.g., a distinctive sub-corridor or room) that can be subjected to invalidating events without changing reward topology. Matched seeds, matched total step count, matched reward exposure. Both arms then transition to sleep-mode with the same offline-duration budget. Primary outcome: count(SWR-equivalent replay events over region R) during first offline bout, reported as a ratio A/B and as a per-seed delta. Pre-registered threshold: arm-A-vs-arm-B replay-count-over-R ratio >= 1.5 (one-sided, distinct seeds, >= 4 seed pairs). items.design: Discriminative pair, MECH-290 ON vs OFF, matched seeds. items.notes: OCD Layer 2 hypothesis test. The architectural reading: without an action-chunk cache substrate (SD-045 -- V4 default with V3 pull-forward), every action goes through model-based planning, and MECH-290 backward credit sweep reinforces residue terrain along the planner's chosen trajectories -- this self-reinforcement IS a chunk cache, just one with no chunk-level No-Go. The planner becomes increasingly biased toward the same trajectory shape because the residue field rewards it. PASS confirms this self-reinforcement loop is a meaningful monostrategy contributor; FAIL rules out Layer 2 and points the architectural diagnostic toward Layer 3 (single-slot GoalState forces single strategy structurally, not parametrically). The ON arm uses MECH-290 default config (backward_sweep_gamma=0.9, backward_sweep_min_quality=0.6); the OFF arm sets use_backward_credit_sweep=False. Both arms keep ResidueField + valence writes intact -- only the post-commit credit-sweep path is ablated. This is the cheapest Layer 2 test (one config flag flip; no new substrate). Independent of EXQ-490/490b V_s pathway. Successor experiments if PASS: (a) gradient sweep of backward_sweep_gamma to find the threshold where self-reinforcement attenuation breaks the OCD-runaway pattern without losing legitimate goal-directed credit assignment, (b) SD-045 pull-forward design pass for an explicit chunk No-Go that operates without ablating the credit sweep. Successor if FAIL: SD-046 design pass for multi-slot GoalState architecture (Layer 3). Candidate script name: v3_exq_499_ocd_layer2_mech290_ablation.py. See REE_assembly/docs/architecture/psychiatric_failure_modes.md OCD section.
items.objective: Test OCD Layer 2 hypothesis from REE_assembly/docs/architecture/psychiatric_failure_modes.md (2026-04-28 OCD section): does the MECH-290 backward credit sweep -- which reinforces residue terrain along committed trajectories via VALENCE_WANTING writes scaled by gamma decay from outcome quality -- contribute to V3 monostrategy by self-reinforcing the planner's preferred trajectory shape? PASS = ablating MECH-290 attenuates baseline monostrategy; supports Layer 2 (chunk-side runaway analogue) as a contributor and licenses SD-045 action_chunk_cache pull-forward to V3 to add an explicit chunk No-Go (the architectural fix). FAIL = MECH-290 ablation has no monostrategy effect; rules out Layer 2, escalates to Layer 3 (SD-046 multi-slot GoalState pull-forward) as the next architectural diagnostic.

items.design: Two-arm matched-seed exploratory probe. Arm A (chronic load): drive_level pinned high (0.9) for 1000 sustained steps in CausalGridWorldV2 with all SD-032 cluster substrates ON (use_salience_coordinator, use_aic_analog, use_pcc_analog, use_pacc_analog, use_dacc all True). Arm B (nominal): identical config but drive_level held at nominal baseline (0.5) for same duration and seed-set. 3 seeds matched across arms. Telemetry: log per-step ARC-016 commit_threshold, SD-032a coordinator effective_threshold (post pcc_stability and pacc drive_bias modulation), AIC aic_salience baseline, dACC pe normalisation scale, beta-gate release threshold, SD-032e drive_bias. Primary analysis: principal-component decomposition of the joint threshold trajectory in Arm A. PASS-coherent (Q-041 -> 'no supervisor needed'): >= 80% of variance in Arm A on a single PC, AND that PC shows monotone shift relative to Arm B baseline. PASS-independent (Q-041 -> 'cluster justified'): top PC explains <= 50% variance, indicating substrate-independent drift. Mixed (most likely): 50-80% variance on top PC -- indicates partial coupling, points at which loci share a hidden signal vs which are genuinely independent. Secondary: pairwise correlation matrix of the six threshold time-series; identify the most-decoupled pair as the strongest argument for or against a supervisor.
items.notes: Research-anchor framing per Q-041 registration. Lightweight: no new substrate code required, just telemetry hooks on existing loci. The exploratory_probe dispatch is intentional -- this is a regime characterisation, not a discriminative pair, because Q-041 itself is asking whether the regime exists at all. If PCA result is decisive (>= 80% on PC1 or <= 50% on PC1), Q-041 narrows toward closure or cluster registration respectively; if mixed, the result becomes input to a follow-up discriminative pair on the most-decoupled pair of loci. Gated on V_s-monostrategy substrate clearing because chronic load currently produces lock-in regardless of threshold dynamics, which would mask the signature this probe measures. Companion successor proposal (literature, not yet registered): targeted lit-pull on 'adaptive learning rate dACC volatility' + 'neuromodulator setpoint chronic stress recalibration' + 'synaptic homeostasis SHY recalibration' to firm the claim text before any cluster-promotion decision. acceptance_checks: PASS: integrated-arm (world-model R2 + affordance accuracy) exceeds the additive baseline (sum of isolated marginal gains) by the pre-registered margin.
FAIL: integrated arm at-or-below the additive baseline (integration is merely additive, not super-additive).

NON-DEGENERACY / READINESS GATE (else substrate_not_ready_requeue, NOT a FAIL) -- concrete thresholds set by lit-pull targeted_review_mech_423_integration_prerequisites (2026-06-12): the integrated arm is only interpretable as evidence about MECH-423 when R1 AND R2 AND R3 all hold at measurement time. R1 (COUPLING -- shared latent doing genuine, non-destructive cross-module work; grounds Yu/PCGrad NeurIPS2020 + Caruana 1997): NON-ZERO shared-latent gradient norm in each module [||grad_z|| > 0; if ~0 the latent is uncoupled and integrated==isolated by construction] AND the mean pairwise cosine similarity between per-module gradients on the shared L-space latent is NOT NET-NEGATIVE [mean inter-module gradient cosine >= 0; a net-negative cosine is the negative-transfer regime where sub-additivity is the EXPECTED consequence of gradient conflict, not a refutation -> re-scope/route substrate_not_ready, never FAIL]. R2 (INFERENCE CONVERGENCE; grounds Gershman & Goodman 2014 amortized inference): the shared posterior over z is stable at readout -- per-inference-step ||delta z_shared|| < 0.05 * ||z_shared|| (loop converged); if an amortized recognition map is used, its held-out reconstruction/ELBO has plateaued (amortization gap closed). R3 (OFFLINE INTERLEAVING ACTIVE; grounds McClelland/McNaughton/O'Reilly 1995 + Kumaran/Hassabis/McClelland 2016 CLS): MECH-121 replay/consolidation running (consolidation updates per epoch > 0) AND interleaving cross-module traces (cross-module replay share > 0) AND the integrated representation acquired under an INTERLEAVED, not blocked single-module, schedule [blocked schedule -> catastrophic interference -> sub-additive artefact]. Any of R1/R2/R3 failing -> check_degeneracy non_degenerate=false, substrate_not_ready_requeue.

SUPER-ADDITIVITY MARGIN (pre-registered, statistical not absolute): with R1-R3 satisfied, PASS requires integrated-arm score (world-model R2 + affordance accuracy) MINUS additive baseline (sum of isolated marginal gains) > 2 x across-seed SD of the baseline, on >= 2/3 seeds. Positive-but-below-margin = inconclusive/additive-only (NOT weakens). At-or-below baseline with R1-R3 satisfied and mean gradient cosine >= 0 = genuine FAIL (integration merely additive). REGIME CAVEAT (Kumaran 2016 schema-consistency + Caruana 1997 relatedness): the INTEGRATED-PAIR arm must pair modules whose features genuinely overlap (E1<->E2 is the registered overlap instance) with that relatedness pre-registered, so a null is not misattributed to integration failure when it is module-unrelatedness.

acceptance_checks: PASS: selected-candidate true-quality is LOWER under ARM NON-POTENTIAL than CTRL, AND ARM POTENTIAL is statistically indistinguishable from CTRL, on >=2/3 seeds (the dissociation: untethered diverts, tethered does not).

FAIL: the non-potential proxy does NOT lower selected true-quality (the tethering constraint is not load-bearing on this substrate), OR the potential proxy also diverts (the potential construction is mis-specified).

NON-DEGENERACY / READINESS (else substrate_not_ready_requeue, NOT a FAIL): the clean-goal optimum must be DISCRIMINABLE -- selected-candidate true-quality must have non-zero range across proxy conditions on the identical base landscape [else there is no optimum to divert from]; the uncommitted (multinomial) E3 regime must be active per the 674 finding [temperature-blind argmin branch would mask the effect]; check_degeneracy non_degenerate=false otherwise.
items.design: Controlled E3-selection probe in the V3-EXQ-674 family (no env / no training -> avoids monostrategy / z_goal-collapse confounds). Identical base score landscape across arms. ARM CTRL: no proxy. ARM NON-POTENTIAL: a raw progress bonus (a non-potential function of goal-proximity) added to the per-candidate score landscape. ARM POTENTIAL: a potential-difference proxy gamma*Phi(s')-Phi(s) over the SAME proximity Phi. Metric: TRUE (clean-landscape) quality of the E3-selected candidate. Prediction: NON-POTENTIAL drops selected true-quality vs CTRL (behaviour diverted); POTENTIAL preserves it (policy-invariant per Ng/Harada/Russell1999).

acceptance_checks: PASS / supports MECH-451 (REPRESENTATIONAL COMPRESSION is the binding constraint): A2_FINER_CHANNELS lifts committed-action-class entropy strict-above BOTH A0 AND A1_GLOBAL_WCHAN AND the verified-lifting noise control, converting >=1 previously-F-dominated NON-MOTOR control function to committed authority, on >=2/3 seeds. items.design: SIBLING of V3-EXQ-700 (same GAP-A-ready foraging substrate, same matched arithmetic envelope as a constant on all arms; the ONLY change is the score_bias channel granularity feeding the ARC-108 learner). To be authored via /queue-experiment AFTER V3-EXQ-700 returns: if 700 already converts on A1, this is MOOT (do not queue); if 700 shows preconditions-met-no-lift, this is the first cheap thing to try before ARC-110. acceptance_checks: PASS / supports ARC-005 (the plane ROUTES): channel intervention shifts precision and mode occupancy monotonically with channel setting, AND the channel main effect on mode occupancy exceeds the content main effect by >= 0.8 SD of the cross-seed DELTA and by an absolute floor of >= 0.15 occupancy-fraction, AND identical channel settings reproduce the same regime across content A and content B, on >= 2/3 seeds.

FAIL / weakens ARC-005 (readout, not router): mode occupancy and precision are predicted as well or better from content features than from channel settings (content main effect >= channel main effect). ARC-005 demotes; the 88 dependents require re-derivation from whatever actually routes. This is a decision-flipping negative, not a null.

NON-DEGENERACY (else substrate_not_ready_requeue, NOT a verdict): (a) in A0_BASE at least two modes occupied >= 5% of steps -- a single-mode-collapsed agent makes all arms trivially identical; (b) the precision readout must carry non-zero cross-seed variance, not floor-pinned; (c) the channel perturbation must actually move the channel state (verify the settings took effect, not just that they were passed). check_degeneracy non_degenerate=false on any failing.
items.design: DOUBLE DISSOCIATION 2x2 over the implemented channel set (serotonin rigidity, regulators/phasic_surprise_burst gain, cingulate/salience_coordinator mode prior, pcc_analog pcc_stability mu). Factor 1 = channel settings {baseline, perturbed}; Factor 2 = task content {content-set A, content-set B} on a fixed arena. Arms: A0_BASE (baseline channels, content A) / A1_CHAN (perturbed channels, content A) / A2_CONTENT (baseline channels, content B) / A3_BOTH (perturbed channels, content B). Primary DVs: (i) E3 precision readout, (ii) mode-occupancy distribution over the control-plane regimes. The comparison of interest is the CHANNEL main effect vs the CONTENT main effect on mode occupancy, on matched seeds. Author via /queue-experiment; Step-2.5 substrate-readiness must confirm all four channels are externally settable from the experiment driver and that a mode-occupancy readout is emitted per step (else blocked_substrate). items.execution_note: Queued as V3-EXQ-802 (script ree-v3/experiments/v3_exq_802_arc005_control_plane_routing_double_dissociation.py). Design followed as specified, with three measured substrate-readiness fixes (dACC+AIC on, phasic source instantaneous_pe, 5-HT set at the channel output) and ONE deliberate deviation: the mandatory non-degeneracy precondition was RESCOPED from per-arm 'baseline occupies >=2 modes' to design-level '>=2 distinct argmax modes across the design'. items.notes: Minted by /thought-digestion 2026-07-21 while digesting the load-bearing ARC spine. ARC-005 was the highest-fan-in claim in the registry (88 reverse deps) with a completely absent falsification condition and zero experimental evidence -- carried entirely on literature and on being architecturally load-bearing. SCOPE: tests routing authority over the CURRENTLY-IMPLEMENTED channels only; a PASS does not vindicate every channel posited in MECH-002/MECH-004, it establishes the plane is causal rather than decorative. Relates to Q-017 (minimal orthogonal control-axis subset) and MECH-063 (orthogonal tonic/phasic axes) -- a FAIL here would make both moot. Digestion proposes; it does not promote. ARC-005 stays believed until an experiment scores.
items.objective: Test ARC-005's falsifiable content -- not that a control plane EXISTS (a design fact) but that it ROUTES: that its channels have causal authority over precision and mode DISSOCIABLE FROM CONTENT. ARC-005 carries 88 reverse dependencies on exp_conf 0.0 (zero experimental entries; lit_conf 0.783 only). If precision and mode are readouts of what the agent happens to be processing rather than settings the plane imposes, the plane is epiphenomenal and the whole E1/E2/E3 + neuromodulator dependency spine inherits a false premise.

acceptance_checks: PASS / supports ARC-007 leg 2 (paths ARE through residue terrain): A2_RESIDUE_PERMUTED and A3_RESIDUE_FROZEN degrade toward A1_HIPPO_ABLATED, recovering >= 50% of the A0->A1 harm gap, with an effect >= 0.8 SD of the cross-seed delta, on >= 2/3 seeds.

FAIL / weakens ARC-007 leg 2 (terrain claim false; leg 1 survives): A2/A3 statistically indistinguishable from intact A0. Path memory works but not through residue terrain. ARC-007 must be SPLIT -- the path-memory leg promotes on EXQ-114, the residue-terrain leg demotes, and dependents assuming residue-shaped terrain (MECH-073 value-shaped hippocampal geometry, the MECH-269/270/271/273 replay cluster) need re-derivation. Decision-flipping negative, not a null.

NON-DEGENERACY (else substrate_not_ready_requeue, NOT a verdict): (a) the residue field must carry live non-flat structure in A0 -- non-zero cross-cell variance, not uniform-pinned; permuting a flat field is a no-op and would manufacture a false FAIL; (b) the A0->A1 harm gap must reproduce EXQ-114's magnitude, else there is no base effect to attribute; (c) the permutation must verifiably change the field state, not merely be requested. check_degeneracy non_degenerate=false on any failing.

items.objective: Test the UNTESTED leg of ARC-007. acceptance_checks: PASS / supports ARC-003 leg A: the E3 score gradient is non-flat, predicts the taken candidate above chance, and A1_E3_LESIONED collapses the selected-candidate distribution toward the generation prior (KL drop >= 0.8 SD of the cross-seed delta), on >= 2/3 seeds.

A pool of near-identical candidates makes the score gradient trivially flat and would manufacture a false FAIL. items.design: Score-level ablation, NO sustained-execution DV. Arms: A0_INTACT (full E3 scoring over the candidate set) / A1_E3_LESIONED (E3 contribution to the candidate score removed, candidate generation untouched) / ARM_NOISE (matched-noise temperature control, verified-lifting). Primary DVs: (i) flatness of the E3 score gradient across the candidate pool, (ii) above-chance prediction of the taken candidate from the E3 score, (iii) divergence between the selected-candidate distribution and the proposer's generation prior (KL). Everything is read at selection time -- the agent never needs to hold or execute a multi-step plan, which is what keeps this runnable while the BG layer is in flight. items.objective: Test the OPEN leg of ARC-018 -- 'explicit rollouts' -- with the two confounds that spoiled both prior attempts explicitly trapped. ARC-018's PASS/FAIL split is not noise: every PASS (EXQ-042, EXQ-053, EXQ-120) tested the post-commitment VIABILITY MAPPING leg, and every FAIL (EXQ-172, EXQ-196) tested the ROLLOUT leg. Carrying the conjunction at exp_conf 0.547 averages a well-supported leg with an unsupported one and hides both facts. Critically the rollout leg is UNTESTED, NOT REFUTED: EXQ-172 ran at e2_world_r2 = 0.203 (its own note concludes ARC-018 'may be E2-quality-gated' -- a negative advantage from a poor forward model indicts E2, not the architecture), and EXQ-196 returned harm_advantage_mean EXACTLY 0.0 on all 3 seeds at good fidelity (e2_world_r2 0.766), an exact-zero-everywhere degeneracy signature meaning the rollout output never reached the DV -- which is why governance classified it non_contributory and deferred the verdict.

acceptance_checks: PASS / the 396-series result was a calibration artefact and ARC-016's validation stands unqualified: under A1_EVAL_DERIVED (and/or A2_ONLINE_ADAPTED) the commitment threshold ENGAGES during eval and commit_rate tracks manipulated precision monotonically, reproducing the EXQ-018b direction (higher precision -> higher commit_rate), while A0_TRAIN_BASELINE reproduces the 396 non-engagement.

The 15 prior FAILs would then need re-reading as right for the wrong reasons, and ARC-016 demotes from provisional. Decision-flipping negative.

NON-DEGENERACY + SCOPE (else substrate_not_ready_requeue, NOT a verdict): (a) THE THRESHOLD MUST ACTUALLY ENGAGE -- commit_rate strictly between floor and ceiling, not pinned at 0.0 or 1.0, and eval-time variance within the threshold's dynamic range; a threshold that never fires makes all arms identical and is exactly what voided EXQ-396a/b. (b) SCOPE GUARD: structural only -- do NOT attach a behavioural harm DV, which re-imports the V_s monostrategy-lock confound that voided EXQ-454; the behavioural consequence layer is ARC-029, split off 2026-03-22.

STRUCTURAL ONLY -- no behavioural harm DV (see acceptance check 3). Cheap: no sustained multi-step commitment required, so it dodges the BG/action-commitment block. Phase 3: re-measure performance on the UNRELATED previously-acquired competences. PRIMARY DV: change in unrelated-competence performance as a function of targeted-update strength.
