items.gating_reason: DECLINED at the /queue-experiment substrate-readiness guardrail (2026-08-27). The design's own pre-registered non-degeneracy gate is EMPIRICALLY UNREACHABLE on the current commit gate, measured 3/3 seeds in the boundary regime this proposal exists to create. (1) The REACHABILITY sentence in MECH-465's what_would_answer -- 'settled on recorded data, no longer open', citing rv p5 0.00259 / p25 0.00330 / median 0.00562 / p75 0.00618 / p95 0.00720 -- reproduces EXACTLY as the POOLED-ACROSS-SEEDS distribution of V3-EXQ-785a's per-tick rv. Post-warmup WITHIN-seed IQR/median is 0.0104-0.0848, not 0.51: the pre-registered P2 floor IS the pooled figure, and pooled dispersion here is almost entirely BETWEEN-seed. Urgency sweeps the threshold +29% across the grid, larger than the whole within-seed rv spread, so per seed the gate is a STEP function of urgency and the residual DV's own empirical-CDF counterfactual predicts exactly that step. Scored pooled, P1/P2 pass while measuring seed identity; scored per-seed they fail. This is the same class of arithmetic-determination defect the 2026-08-26 digestion pass caught one level up -- P3 strips the threshold sliding against a fixed distribution, but not the distribution being five point masses. (2) A 4000-point geometric threshold sweep over the recorded post-warmup rv finds ZERO thresholds satisfying P1 ('commit rate at EVERY urgency level in [0.05,0.95]') on ANY of the 5 seeds (best 5/6, seed 3); only the POOLED distribution appears feasible, which is the artefact. Per-seed centred calibration and grid-narrowing were both tested on recorded data and both fail as general designs. (3) LIVE PROBE, replicating the 785a harness exactly (alpha_world 0.9, gain 0.5, 600 ticks, post-warmup tick>=90) at ree-v3 post-2023589: P2 fails 3/3 by 11-19x (IQR/median 0.0266 / 0.0450 / 0.0279 vs the 0.51 floor) and P1 fails 3/3 (seed 3 floor-pinned at 0.0 on all six levels; seed 0 ceiling-pinned at 1.0 on four; seed 1 breaches the 0.95 ceiling on three). The boundary regime shifts the rv LOCATION substantially, as the proposal predicted, but leaves DISPERSION a point mass -- and dispersion is what P2 and P3 need. (4) A third failure the recorded data could not show: the calibration target moves further than the band is wide. Seed 3, calibrated at 0.00283 against a recorded median of 0.003366, realised a median of 0.008918 under that threshold (3.15x the threshold, commitment never fires); seed 0 moved -35%. The induced perturbation (35-165%) is 7-50x the graded band's width (2.7-4.5%), so the proposal's '3-threshold x 1-seed x 500-tick sweep' has no demonstrated stable operating point. ROOT CAUSE: the gate reads commit_variance = E3._running_variance, an EMA at precision_ema_alpha=0.05 (~20-tick time constant) over world-model prediction error, which in a stationary env converges to a per-seed near-point-mass -- structurally the wrong quantity to place a threshold inside. Both substrate alternatives that WOULD carry within-run dispersion are select()-level kwargs with ZERO occurrences in agent.py, so the live agent path always gates on the EMA. DO NOT resolve by lowering the P2 floor (/queue-experiment Step 3: a pre-registered value that provably fails a gate is a design-time proof, not a substrate fact). PRIOR ART, read after the initial block and CORROBORATING it by an independent route: the 2026-07-20 stage-1 and 2026-07-21 stage-2 MECH-465 spikes (evidence/planning/mech465_commit_gate_boundary_spike_2026-07-20.md, mech465_stage2_conditional_gate_probe_2026-07-21.md) had ALREADY established that the boundary regime is not reachable -- rv at 1.02-1.07x, and SD-063's trained conditional gate at 1.2473x in the deployment condition -- and located the binding constraint UPSTREAM at the untrained z_world encoder. The 2026-08-26 digestion pass that minted this proposal asserted 'REACHABILITY (settled on recorded data, no longer open)' without reconciling those two artifacts, which say the opposite; that is the substance of governance flag GFLAG-0056. acceptance_checks: NON-DEGENERACY 1: chunks actually form, checked from PER-SEED rows against a pre-registered worst-seed floor BEFORE any downstream statistic is trusted. Use V3-EXQ-810a's calibrated bar (cleared 7/8 seeds vs a 0.75 fraction; worst-seed margins 2.4x-7.0x); do not invent a new one. V3-EXQ-834 is the counter-example making this per-seed: it returned precondition_unmet on chunks_formed while 4/5 seeds HAD formed 8-44 chunks each -- a driver gate-strictness defect, not a substrate ceiling.

NON-DEGENERACY 2: outcome span PRE-REGISTERED and >= 2.0. F_low/F_high are SCALE-RELATIVE (policy_chunking._variance is plain population variance over the raw unbounded E3-score-receipt scalar; no normalisation anywhere). Population variance on a span-S range is at most S^2/4, so at F_high=0.45 dissolution needs S > 1.342. AT THE REGISTERED DEFAULTS ON A 0-1 SCALE THE CRYSTALLISED->DISSOLVING TRANSITION IS ARITHMETICALLY IMPOSSIBLE, taking DISSOLVED and all three relapse falsifiers out of reach. Emit the reachability arithmetic as an explicit per-cell precondition.

NON-DEGENERACY 3: use_reacquisition_window_isolation ON, and report r_reacq/W per cell as a standing degeneracy check. r_reacq/W ~ 0.9 with low variance means the INSTRUMENT produced the number, not the claim.

NON-DEGENERACY 4: retention state DECLARED per arm (with retention ON the bar is ceil(R_min * f_reacq) for any sequence carrying a dormant chunk, so R_min and R_reacq cells are otherwise silently pooled); and persistence flags scoped to the PROBE phase only, formation at lineage defaults (the V3-EXQ-871 guard: cell-wide flags perturb formation via RNG-coupled env dynamics, same seeds 101/505 forming 1/0 chunks vs 2/2 under 841).

TARGET THE RELATIONS, NEVER THE CONSTANTS. R_min=20, W=100, F_low=0.15, F_high=0.45, f_reacq=0.25, chunk size 2-5 are UNCALIBRATED ENGINEERING DEFAULTS with no literature support; only the orderings are grounded (Barnes 2005; Bouton 2012; Ramkumar 2016; Bo/Seidler 2009). A result turning on a specific value scores nothing.

PASS (MECH-323 C2 / MECH-324 F1): re-formation of a dormant chunk under an identical consistent above-baseline regime completes in STRICTLY FEWER repetitions than first acquisition of the SAME sequence, with r_acq measured on the same run -- r_reacq < r_acq -- AND r_reacq monotonic-decreasing in f_reacq across >=3 levels (a rank ordering, not a value match).

FAIL: r_reacq >= r_acq with the isolation flag ON and the formation precondition met -- falsifies the state-dependence itself, not merely f_reacq's value. DISTINGUISH FROM: r_reacq FLAT across f_reacq with r_reacq/W no longer tracking W, which is the genuine structural falsification that V3-EXQ-829's result was mistaken for.

PASS (MECH-324 C2/C3/C4): retention-not-erasure holds (829's C3 already clean: dormant-flag OFF -> 12/12 dissolved cells stayed dead, ON -> revived); hysteresis measured as CROSSINGS not read off config (F_high > F_low as measured crossing points AND dissolution taking strictly more trials than formation on the same sequence in the same run); recoverability from DISSOLVING holds.

OUT OF SCOPE, do not smuggle in: MECH-324's renewal (F4) and resurgence (F5) legs. F4 is blocked UPSTREAM on MECH-323's never-populated initiation_set (ChunkedPrimitive.initiation_set defaults to frozenset(), neither mint call site populates it, verified unchanged 2026-08-28) and ultimately on a bucket-count measurement rooted in SD-008 z_world under-differentiation. F5 needs a library-level competition term that does not exist. Carry both as named residuals.

acceptance_checks: ARMED-CONVERSION P1 (mandatory, asserted from MEASURED per-arm quantities, not from config): mean_distinct_first_action_classes >= 0.9 * action_dim in EVERY arm. The 2026-08-23 spike measured 2.16 distinct classes of 5 on a minimal build and 3.08 on a rich build at the default; setting the knob to action_dim gives 4.98 with no code change.
ARMED-CONVERSION P2 (mandatory): authority_rel_deviation_mean > 0.05 in every lever-bearing arm; ~1e-8 is the OFF signature. Already armed in the 708a/708b drivers -- assert it rather than assume it.

VACUITY RULE: a committed-action-diversity null with EITHER clamp in place must self-route substrate_not_ready_requeue, NEVER weakens. Established by V3-EXQ-949's strict AND-interaction (yoked divergence 0.000 with P1 alone, 0.000 with P2 alone, 0.3675 with both, 5 seeds).

CEILING-HEADROOM CHECK (precondition on the FALSIFYING branch specifically): fraction-of-ceiling in the ALL-OFF arm must be materially below 1.0. A null in the OFF arm is uninformative -- there is nothing to lift.

MANDATORY INSTRUMENTS, whose absence made the prior lineage unreadable: (i) mean_distinct_first_action_classes per arm as a covariate, with the DV reported as a FRACTION of ln(distinct) rather than an absolute nat count; (ii) yoked per-tick committed-action divergence against a matched control sharing a PRIVATE RNG stream (the V3-EXQ-949 design), which detects authority acquisition even when episode-level entropy has not moved; (iii) authority_rel_deviation_mean per arm.

PASS: with P1 armed, ARM_NOISE produces committed (argmax) selected_action_entropy -- as fraction-of-ceiling -- STRICTLY ABOVE the matched-pre-commit-variance ARM_TEMP control on >=2/3 seeds, with the diversity reaching the COMMITTED action.

SECONDARY (both asserted by MECH-440 and NEITHER ever measured): STATE-CONDITIONING -- per-state noise magnitude covaries with state rather than being uniform; SELF-ANNEALING -- per-parameter sigma (or the local confidence EMA standing in for it) FALLS where the policy is confident. A run confirming only the entropy lift establishes propagation and leaves two thirds of the claim untested.

FAIL: (a) washes out at the argmax identically to the temperature floor (valid ONLY once the ceiling-headroom check passes); or (b) raises pre-commit entropy without raising committed-action diversity -- thrash, not carve; or (c) raises committed diversity but the noise is measurably state-INDEPENDENT and non-annealing, supporting a plain stochastic floor (MECH-313's original framing) and refuting MECH-440's refinement while leaving the injection-site correction standing.

HONEST LIMIT, do not over-read: V3-EXQ-949's DV is per-tick committed-ACTION divergence in a yoked pair, not committed-CLASS entropy over an episode. It proves the channel acquires argmin authority; it does NOT prove that authority converts into sustained class diversity. That conversion is what THIS run must measure.
SCOPE: this does NOT refute MECH-439 F-dominance or ARC-110's intrinsic-ceiling finding; both may still hold at a raised floor. A null here at a raised floor is a genuine result for the first time.
items.design: The V3-EXQ-708b design WITH ONE INTEGER CHANGED: support_preserving_min_first_action_classes = action_dim (708b sets 2 at driver line 507). INV-060 is invariant_type=emergent, emergent_from ARC-049 (play_frame_tag) and depends_on INV-055/INV-058/INV-041/ARC-049; ARC-049 + the whole play-mode cluster (ARC-049/050, MECH-194..199, INV-058/059/060, Q-035) are candidate/substrate_conditional and UNIMPLEMENTED (verified 2026-06-07 and reconfirmed 2026-07-11). Verified in ree_core: (1) HippocampalModule.reverse_replay() (module.py:2229, MECH-165) is a PURE temporal reversal of states/actions/world_states and does not write valence. (2) The offline REM/SWS reverse-replay path (agent.py run_rem_attribution_pass, ~10105-10194) is EXPLICITLY read-only: it scores residue terrain per trajectory WITHOUT accumulating (hypothesis_tag=True per MECH-094) and never calls update_valence. (3) HippocampalModule.backward_credit_sweep() (module.py:2473, MECH-290) does spread wanting backward with gamma^steps decay, but it is the WAKING analog -- fires at BetaGate release on the committed trajectory (hypothesis_tag=False), a different claim. So no offline wanting-spread write path exists to measure. An experiment queued now would exercise nonexistent code and FAIL vacuously (no gradient forms), re-deriving substrate absence rather than adjudicating the claim. Sibling MECH-216 (waking schema-conditioning, agent.py:9711 _seed_valence_from_schema) IS built and tested (v3_exq_263a/263b/332/332a). This is complicated (buildable), not a dead end: the claim notes give the exact recipe and the sole substrate dependency MECH-165 is implemented. /implement-substrate build chip spawned.
